article.title: 때문에
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: **때문** is a bound noun meaning the cause or reason for an event; in **N 때문에**, a noun phrase supplies that cause. This entry is limited to this basic causal construction and does not assert that it is restricted to negative outcomes.
